facts: Mobileye disclosed that on September 3, 2026, Executive Vice President Business Development & Strategy Nimrod Nehushtan transitioned to a part-time role focused on corporate strategy.
Mobileye disclosed that Vice President of Business Development Nimrod Brickman will continue to lead the company's business development activities following the transition.
As of the September 10 filing, Nehushtan's existing compensation arrangements had not been modified in connection with the role transition.

factors.name: governancePower
factors.basis: A senior business-development/strategy responsibility changed hands during a period when Mobileye is trying to convert advanced-product and autonomy programs into commercial growth. The filing establishes continuity of business-development leadership but does not establish the operating effect of the transition.

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: Council Alpha can monitor whether the leadership transition changes customer-win cadence, partnership execution or commercialization disclosures; the filing itself does not evidence deterioration or improvement.

risks.risk: A senior strategy/business-development transition can create execution or relationship continuity risk, but inferring a negative business impact from the personnel change alone would manufacture certainty beyond the filing.

contradictions: The filing documents a real senior-role transition while also documenting continuity through the existing Vice President of Business Development; it does not support treating the change as either a confirmed disruption or a confirmed improvement.
unknowns: Why Nehushtan transitioned to part-time status.
Whether responsibilities beyond business development were redistributed and, if so, to whom.
Whether the transition will measurably affect design-win, partnership or commercialization execution.
